description:
Let rain, ocean waves, streams, birdsong and meditation music accompany rest, focus and a return to your breath.

Yixiu is a quiet space where sound brings you back to the present. No account, no ads and no streaks to maintain—just nature sounds and gentle rhythms when you need them.

14 REAL NATURE SOUNDS
Ocean waves, rain on eaves, spring creek, morning birds, mountain stream, morning lake, valley breeze, bamboo rain, forest waterfall, window rain, distant thunder, underwater echo, snow wind and night tide. Every sound has an immersive scene.

14 MEDITATION TRACKS
Five long tracks around 20 minutes, five short 88-second tracks, and three ambient selections: Cloud Drift, Soft Light Rest and Deep Water Rest. Quiet Hour adds a full 60-minute extended edit based on HoliznaCC0's original recording, with a smooth crossfade into a repeated section. It is clearly labeled an extended edit, not an original one-hour composition. Original titles, creators and licenses are available in My Yixiu > Sources.

FREE & YIXIU PLUS
Enjoy five nature sounds and three meditation tracks for free: Oasis Rest, Ocean Passage and First Breath. Yixiu Plus unlocks all 14 nature sounds and 14 meditation tracks, 60-minute/unlimited listening and 3-, 5- and 10-minute breathing. Verified owners of Yixiu 1.2 or earlier retain their previous nature sounds and existing benefits.

A SOUND SPACE FOR REST, FOCUS & READING
Free timers offer 5, 15 and 30 minutes; Plus adds 60 minutes and unlimited listening. Enable background playback to keep listening when leaving the app. Choose 60 minutes or unlimited for the full Quiet Hour track. An optional end bell is available in My Yixiu, off by default; it does not replace a system alarm.

ONE-MINUTE WATER BREATH
Follow a gentle rhythm of inhale, hold and exhale. Focus uses the same artwork, title and optional sound as your current listening scene. Compact shortcuts make starting a practice simple.

KEEP YOUR OWN RHYTHM
Favorite sounds, continue recent listening, set a default duration and switch between Chinese and English. Preferences and completed practice records stay on your device. Optional local daily reminders, widgets and Live Activity are included.

True to yourself. Flow with life.
